words: Snow is falling from the clouds. What is the weather?
Look for the weather word for falling snow, not raindrops.
Snow gets warm and turns into water. What does it do?
The snow changes from solid snow into liquid water.
What do we call one tiny piece of snow that falls from a cloud?
It is one little piece of falling snow.
What do you call a figure made of snow that looks like a person?
People can build it from big balls of snow and add a carrot nose.
You slide down a snowy hill on two long boards attached to your boots. What do you do?
Think of moving over snow with long boards on your feet.
You press snow into a small round ball. What have you made?
It is a round ball made of snow.
